journey.title: Delete a note
steps: Add a note with the text "Buy milk".
Click Delete on the "Buy milk" note.
Confirm that the note disappears from the list.

observations.name: note_count
observations.instruction: Count the note rows on the notes page and store the number as 'note_count'.

observations.name: shown_text
observations.instruction: Read the text of the note you just added in the notes list and store it exactly as shown as 'shown_text'.
